verdict.rationale: Intel's own docs tout Arc graphics, XeSS 3, and FPS-boosting tools (Binary Optimization Tool, Application Optimization) for gaming, but this is a low-power V-series chip and the evidence pack contains no independent game benchmarks or hands-on frame-rate testing to corroborate these vendor claims. missing for 10: independent/third-party gaming benchmarks, actual FPS numbers in real titles, comparison vs competitor GPUs.
